correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the corner-transfer model and strict quadratic-column height. Each rising link is the flag complex of a line graph of a specific bipartite graph, homotopy equivalent to its connected nonisolated core. For support size s>=2, edge count s(s-1)/2+t and active-vertex count 2(s-1)+boundary bonuses give precisely binom(s-2,2) plus repeated interior sizes. The unique s=1,m=1 empty-link boundary contributes +1. Euler minimum-clique partitioning proves chi=1+sum r for every n. Independent direct clique Euler checks n<=15, rising-neighbor line graph checks n<=14, and 25 published sequence values agree. The homotopy conclusion correctly invokes the prior all-n wedge theorem.
